**Source file:** `src/...`

**Functions (addresses):** `0x...`

**Working:** by hand / with an agent (which one)

When done, or if you give up, post the output of `py -I tools\cd2.py check <file> --explain` here and close the
issue, so that the next person can start from what you learned.
